page.overview:
Who is Harry and Ginny Potter?

Harry and Ginny Potter were a married couple and the parents of the Albus Potter, Lily L. Potter, James Sirius Potter. They were both Gryffindor students at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and members of the Dumbledore's Army. See their individual articles for more information:
